title: Butterfree’s Toxic Answer to Caterpie Hunters

direction.premise: When bird Pokémon go after Caterpie, Butterfree uses toxic scales to drive them away.
direction.audiencePromise: See why Butterfree’s pretty wing scales make it a dangerous protector for Caterpie.
direction.openLoop: What does Butterfree do when a bird Pokémon targets Caterpie?
direction.payoff: Butterfree drives Caterpie hunters away with toxic scales, and uses those scales to defend itself too.
direction.engagementQuestion: Caterpie guardian or toxic survivor, which Butterfree feels truer?

voice.instructions: Tense and protective at first. Build awe around the toxic scales, then land the final question with a thoughtful pause.

scenes.headline: A TERRIFYING ANSWER
scenes.narration: Butterfree has a terrifying answer for Caterpie hunters.
scenes.caption: A BIRD SWOOPS. BUTTERFREE BLOCKS THE PATH.

scenes.headline: TOXIC SCALES
scenes.narration: Butterfree's wings carry toxic scales, not harmless glittering dust.
scenes.caption: THE SPARKLE IS A WARNING.

scenes.headline: IT STEPS IN
scenes.narration: When bird Pokémon target Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles those scales on them.
scenes.caption: BUTTERFREE INTERCEPTS THE HUNTERS.

scenes.headline: DRIVE THEM AWAY
scenes.narration: Those scales drive birds away. It also releases toxic battle dust.
scenes.caption: A SPARKLING CLOUD BECOMES A TOXIC BARRIER.

scenes.headline: IT PROTECTS ITSELF TOO
scenes.narration: But it scatters poisonous scales when other Pokémon attack it.
scenes.caption: THE SAME DEFENSE WORKS FOR BUTTERFREE.

scenes.headline: GUARDIAN OR SURVIVOR?
scenes.narration: Caterpie's guardian or toxic survivor, which Butterfree feels truer?
scenes.caption: TOXIC SCALES. TWO PURPOSES.
